text: Entry 2077 adds MOZ_GLEAN_INTERESTING_METRICS_FILES to select metric definitions and packages interesting_serverknobs.json for automation to enable otherwise excluded probes. The author states complete metric definitions are required by schema validation. Comments keep security/manager/ssl and update/shared_metrics included because test_pkcs11_module.js runs before knobs apply and BackgroundTask_shouldprocessupdates collects early/outside automation. Those exceptions remain in fixed configuration. Do not assume CI knobs cover every startup recorder. Commented startup/profile files report glinter nits, not a new reproduced failure. No build, Glean schema, test or telemetry runtime ran.
title: Glean probe filtering needs separate automation and early-startup paths
